title: normania nava
intro: Normania nava, commonly known as Indian pennywort or gotu kola, is a herbaceous perennial plant native to tropical regions. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function, and is also used to treat anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Normania nava can be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and its antioxidant properties, which help protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
